shellCommands.command: git status && git log --oneline | head && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200
cat package.json index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

npm ci 2>&1 | tail -5 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && grep -ril "calendar" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100
npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -5

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[],"' | grep -E '^[0-9]'); do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n ' )"; done 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'uikit' | tail -20

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@3.4.2 peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.0.0 peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null

npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils@'^2.6.0' version 2>/dev/null | tail -2; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 dependencies --json 2>/dev/null; npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 --save-exact=false 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -5; git diff --stat

git diff package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist 2>/dev/null | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|typings)"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && ls dist/esm; cat dist/esm/index.d.ts | head -60; ls docs | head; grep -rl "Calendar" dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components && cat DatePicker/DatePicker.d.ts; ls DatePicker; cat DatePicker/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; cat index.d.ts

cat DatePicker/hooks/datePickerStateFactory.d.ts; ls Calendar; cat Calendar/index.d.ts; cat Calendar/Calendar.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "export" Calendar/Calendar.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cat DatePicker/index.d.ts; grep -rn "CalendarCommonProps" -A20 Calendar/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && sed -n 1,200p date-components/README.md | head -150; echo ----; cat date-utils/package.json | grep -E '"version"|"main"|"module"'; grep -n "export" date-utils/dist/esm/index.d.ts | head -20
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs && ls -R | head -50; cat INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -120
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components && cat Calendar.md | head -150; echo ======; sed -n 1,120p DatePicker.md
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils && ls; cat package.json | grep -E '"(types|typings|main|module)"'; find . -name "*.d.ts" | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build && cat typings/dateTime.d.ts | head -80; cat dateTime/format.d.ts; cat dateTime/index.d.ts; cat constants/format.d.ts | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright); git status --short
